import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MAXN = 12;
    static final int INF = 1000000;
    static int N, T;
    static char[][] gridA = new char[MAXN][MAXN];
    static char[][] gridB = new char[MAXN][MAXN];
    static int[][] cost = new int[MAXN][MAXN];
    static int[][][][] route = new int[MAXN][MAXN][MAXN][MAXN];
    static int[] dx = {-1, 1, 0, 0};
    static int[] dy = {0, 0, -1, 1};

    static class Edge {
        int u, v, cap, flow;
        Edge(int u, int v, int cap) {
            this.u = u;
            this.v = v;
            this.cap = cap;
            this.flow = 0;
        }
    }

    static int nodeCnt, S, TNode;
    static int[] dst, cur;
    static List<Edge> edges = new ArrayList<>();
    static List<Integer>[] adj;

    static void addEdge(int u, int v, int cap) {
        edges.add(new Edge(u, v, cap));
        adj[u].add(edges.size() - 1);
        edges.add(new Edge(v, u, 0));
        adj[v].add(edges.size() - 1);
    }

    static boolean bfs() {
        Arrays.fill(dst, -1);
        Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.add(S);
        dst[S] = 0;
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int v = q.poll();
            for (int id : adj[v]) {
                int to = edges.get(id).v;
                if (dst[to] == -1 && edges.get(id).flow < edges.get(id).cap) {
                    q.add(to);
                    dst[to] = dst[v] + 1;
                }
            }
        }
        return dst[TNode] != -1;
    }

    static int dfs(int v, int fl) {
        if (fl == 0) return 0;
        if (v == TNode) return fl;
        for (int i = cur[v]; i < adj[v].size(); i++) {
            cur[v] = i;
            int id = adj[v].get(i);
            int to = edges.get(id).v;
            if (dst[to] != dst[v] + 1) continue;
            int pushed = dfs(to, Math.min(fl, edges.get(id).cap - edges.get(id).flow));
            if (pushed > 0) {
                edges.get(id).flow += pushed;
                edges.get(id ^ 1).flow -= pushed;
                return pushed;
            }
        }
        return 0;
    }

    static int dinic() {
        int flow = 0;
        while (bfs()) {
            Arrays.fill(cur, 0);
            while (true) {
                int pushed = dfs(S, INF);
                if (pushed == 0) break;
                flow += pushed;
            }
        }
        return flow;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        N = sc.nextInt();
        T = sc.nextInt();
        sc.nextLine(); // consume newline
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            String line = sc.nextLine();
            for (int j = 0; j < N; j++) {
                gridA[i][j] = line.charAt(j);
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            String line = sc.nextLine();
            for (int j = 0; j < N; j++) {
                gridB[i][j] = line.charAt(j);
            }
        }

        // Initialize cost
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            Arrays.fill(cost[i], INF);
        }

        // BFS from cells adjacent to 'Z'
        Queue<int[]> q = new LinkedList<>();
        for (int x = 0; x < N; x++) {
            for (int y = 0; y < N; y++) {
                if (gridA[x][y] == 'Z') {
                    for (int d = 0; d < 4; d++) {
                        int nx = x + dx[d];
                        int ny = y + dy[d];
                        if (nx >= 0 && nx < N && ny >= 0 && ny < N && gridA[nx][ny] != 'Y') {
                            cost[nx][ny] = 1;
                            q.add(new int[]{nx, ny});
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int[] cur = q.poll();
            int x = cur[0], y = cur[1];
            for (int d = 0; d < 4; d++) {
                int nx = x + dx[d];
                int ny = y + dy[d];
                if (nx >= 0 && nx < N && ny >= 0 && ny < N && gridA[nx][ny] != 'Y' && gridA[nx][ny] != 'Z' && cost[nx][ny] == INF) {
                    cost[nx][ny] = cost[x][y] + 1;
                    q.add(new int[]{nx, ny});
                }
            }
        }

        // Compute routes
        for (int sx = 0; sx < N; sx++) {
            for (int sy = 0; sy < N; sy++) {
                if (gridA[sx][sy] == 'Y' || gridA[sx][sy] == 'Z') {
                    for (int tx = 0; tx < N; tx++) {
                        Arrays.fill(route[sx][sy][tx], 0);
                    }
                    continue;
                }
                int[][] dist = new int[N][N];
                for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
                    Arrays.fill(dist[i], INF);
                }
                Queue<int[]> q2 = new LinkedList<>();
                dist[sx][sy] = 0;
                q2.add(new int[]{sx, sy});
                while (!q2.isEmpty()) {
                    int[] cur = q2.poll();
                    int x = cur[0], y = cur[1];
                    route[sx][sy][x][y] = 1;
                    if (dist[x][y] >= T || dist[x][y] >= cost[x][y]) continue;
                    for (int d = 0; d < 4; d++) {
                        int nx = x + dx[d];
                        int ny = y + dy[d];
                        if (nx >= 0 && nx < N && ny >= 0 && ny < N &&
                            gridA[nx][ny] != 'Y' && gridA[nx][ny] != 'Z' &&
                            dist[nx][ny] == INF &&
                            dist[x][y] + 1 <= cost[nx][ny]) {
                            dist[nx][ny] = dist[x][y] + 1;
                            q2.add(new int[]{nx, ny});
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        // Build flow network
        S = 0;
        TNode = 2 * N * N + 1;
        nodeCnt = 2 * N * N + 2;
        adj = new ArrayList[nodeCnt];
        for (int i = 0; i < nodeCnt; i++) {
            adj[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        }
        dst = new int[nodeCnt];
        cur = new int[nodeCnt];

        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < N; j++) {
                char c = gridA[i][j];
                if (c > '0' && c <= '9') {
                    addEdge(S, 1 + i * N + j, c - '0');
                }
                c = gridB[i][j];
                if (c > '0' && c <= '9') {
                    addEdge(N * N + 1 + i * N + j, TNode, c - '0');
                }
            }
        }

        for (int x1 = 0; x1 < N; x1++) {
            for (int y1 = 0; y1 < N; y1++) {
                for (int x2 = 0; x2 < N; x2++) {
                    for (int y2 = 0; y2 < N; y2++) {
                        if (route[x1][y1][x2][y2] == 1) {
                            addEdge(1 + x1 * N + y1, N * N + 1 + x2 * N + y2, INF);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        System.out.println(dinic());
        sc.close();
    }
}
